verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's AI tools page says users can "Create campaigns with the AI you already use. Without leaving the chat," which is a first-party claim of natural-language campaign creation. The pricing page also lists "Generative AI features." Beyond campaign creation, the evidence is thin: Analytics AI gives plain-language explanations but takes no commands. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands extend beyond campaign creation (audiences, automations, reporting, sending), detailed docs on how the chat integration works and which AI assistants it supports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
